description: Manages user accounts, roles, and organizational unit settings within the system. This includes retrieving user details, updating roles, and configuring self-management options for organizational units.

endpoints.name: GetUsers
endpoints.description: Get a paginated list of users with filtering and search capabilities. This endpoint supports advanced search criteria through the `request` body's `advancedSearch` array. Each item in `advancedSearch` should be a JSON object with `field`, `operator`, and `value`. For example, to search for users by name, you might use `{"field": "username", "operator": "like", "value": "John%"}`. Common fields include 'username', 'email', 'status', 'orgUnitCode'. Available operators are 'like', 'is', 'not', 'contains', 'startsWith', 'between'.

request.description: User management request with pagination, filters, and advanced search criteria.

example_uses: How can I get a list of all active users?
Find users whose email contains 'example.com' and are in the 'HR' organizational unit.
Show me users created after January 1, 2023, sorted by username, with a page size of 20.
endpoints.when_to_use: To retrieve a list of users, applying filters, pagination, and advanced search criteria based on various user attributes.

endpoints.name: GetUser
endpoints.description: Get details for a specific user by their unique ID.

userId.description: The unique identifier of the user.

example_uses: Retrieve the profile information for user 'john.doe'.
What are the details for user ID 'abc-123'?
Can I see the full record for a specific user?
endpoints.when_to_use: To fetch the complete profile and details of a single user when their ID is known.

endpoints.name: UpdateUserRoles
endpoints.description: Update the roles assigned to a specific user.

userId.description: The unique identifier of the user whose roles are to be updated.

request.description: The request body containing the new roles to assign to the user.

example_uses: Change the roles for user 'jane.smith' to 'Admin' and 'Editor'.
Assign the 'Viewer' role to user 'user123'.
Update the permissions for a specific user account.
endpoints.when_to_use: To modify the security roles or permissions associated with an existing user account.

endpoints.name: GetAvailableRoles
endpoints.description: Retrieve a list of all roles that the current authenticated user is permitted to assign to other users.
example_uses: What roles can I assign to new users?
List all available user roles.
Show me the roles I have permission to manage.
endpoints.when_to_use: To discover the set of roles that can be used when creating or updating user accounts, based on the current user's permissions.

endpoints.name: GetCurrentUserOrgUnit
endpoints.description: Get the organizational unit associated with the currently authenticated user. This information can be used for filtering data relevant to the user's organizational context.
example_uses: What is my current organizational unit?
Retrieve the organizational unit for the logged-in user.
Find out which department I belong to.
endpoints.when_to_use: To determine the organizational context of the current user, often used for data filtering or access control.

endpoints.name: GetOrgUnitSelfManagement
endpoints.description: Retrieve the self-management setting for a specific organizational unit. This setting determines if users within that unit can manage certain aspects of their own accounts or unit settings.

orgUnitCode.description: The unique code of the organizational unit.

example_uses: Check if self-management is enabled for the 'HR' organizational unit.
What is the self-management status for org unit 'FINANCE'?
Get the self-management configuration for a specific department.
endpoints.when_to_use: To query whether self-management features are active for a given organizational unit.

endpoints.name: UpdateOrgUnitSelfManagement
endpoints.description: Update the self-management setting for a specific organizational unit. This allows administrators to enable or disable self-service capabilities for users within that unit.

orgUnitCode.description: The unique code of the organizational unit.

request.description: The request body containing the new self-management setting.

example_uses: Enable self-management for the 'IT' organizational unit.
Disable self-management for org unit 'SALES'.
Change the self-service setting for a department.
endpoints.when_to_use: To modify whether users within a specific organizational unit are allowed to manage certain aspects of their own accounts or unit settings.
